measurement.harness: the root evaluator times each repetition externally with monotonic_ns around a demoted out-of-process worker; candidate-linked code never supplies elapsed time; every repetition gets a fresh writable state directory and a fresh process group with a per-sample timeout and full-group reap; the benchmark binary is sealed root-owned read-only and hash-verified after all repetitions; the frozen database is hash-verified before and after; result digests are validated in the trusted parent against oracles sealed outside the candidate-readable workspace; the fastest-three-of-seven scalarizer keeps shared-host interference from inflating scored latency while remaining impossible for candidate-controlled code to deflate

terminalSeal.attestation: No optimizer pilot, mutation/headroom run, seed-optimizer session, queryable optimizer corpus write, or search-visible state was used; terminal identities, fixtures, scores, and feedback stayed inside capsules/sqlite-speedtest1 and trusted admission evidence.
